title: Discharge and load spreading between different belt widths on a mesh-belt quench-and-temper line
summary: A July 2026 Suneng roller-supported mesh-belt line proposal connects quenching, oil-tank lifting, oil removal, washing and tempering, with belt widths changing along the route. Conveyor review should examine where parts land, how they spread again and whether drive monitoring covers the actual handovers, as well as belt widths.
